authorization.request: 用户报告 DSH Desktop 商城「官网插件列表」加载不出来，并要求去上游解决这个问题，然后把该上线的上线、该提交的提交。

objective: 修复 DSH Desktop 商城「官网完整目录」在慢速网络下始终读不出来的问题，并把官网发现索引的重复下载从浏览器移到宿主落盘缓存。

change.rootCause: 官网发现索引 registry/discovery-index.json 约 10.4 MB（gzip 约 2.5 MB、24,171 条）。旧实现有三处缺陷：目录文档用 cache: no-store 读取，绕过 CDN 的 max-age=300 与 ETag，每次刷新都重新下载；目录、Catalog 主索引与候选记录同时下载，分抢同一条链路；读取期间面板渲染空列表，看起来像失败而不是加载中。远端文档预算（12 秒 / 45 秒）也小于这两份文档在慢速链路上的实际耗时，目录路径还会把浏览器 AbortError 的数值 code 当成错误码，最终退化成 DESKTOP_OPERATION_FAILED。
change.clientBudgets: 远端文档读取使用按体积设定的上限（Catalog 90 秒、目录 240 秒）并区分超时与停滞；只有符合安全格式的字符串才算 Desktop 错误码。插件管理器本地 RPC 的 12 秒预算保持不变。
change.clientDelivery: 发现索引与候选记录改用 HTTP 缓存；Catalog 主索引与榜单文档继续 no-store，因为它们分别被新鲜 Catalog 的 registry.indexSha256 与榜单摘要互相钉死，缓存副本可能与被校验对象不一致。发现索引优先由宿主提供，宿主不可用时保留直连回退。
change.hostCache: 宿主新增受边界约束的落盘缓存服务，按 6 小时 TTL 缓存官网发现索引，经 /api2/dsh-safe-plugin-manager/directory 提供。宿主只做有界传输与结构自检，客户端仍以自己的完整校验为准。
change.loadingUx: 目录读取期间先显示 Catalog 记录并显示已等待秒数，不再渲染空列表。
change.scopeExclusions: 不写真实 DSH Profile，不安装或重启 DSH，不修改 @deepseek-ai/*、DSH 源码或 Catalog pin；合并源码后如需更新 Catalog，另建绑定完整 Commit 的新鲜计划。不改变官网站点本身，不新增上游制品格式。

commands.expected: all disposable Desktop compatibility cases pass
all disposable host discovery cache cases pass
all client download and cache policy cases pass
REGISTRY_OK and full repository suite passes

gates: The plan base Commit remains an ancestor and every scoped precondition hash matches immediately before commit.
Only string error codes in the documented shape are surfaced; a numeric browser abort code never becomes DESKTOP_OPERATION_FAILED.
The discovery and candidate documents use the HTTP cache; the catalog index and ranking documents stay uncached because a digest pins them to another document.
The host discovery cache is bounded, atomic, TTL-limited and never caches or serves a structurally invalid document.
All repository checks, package dry-run, typed-plan verifier and exact-head PR CI pass before merge.
After source merge, Catalog pin advancement uses a separate fresh policy plan; real Profile update and visible Desktop acceptance require a separate confirmed operation.

rollback.source: Revert only this change through a CI-checked PR; current Catalog stays pinned to 0.9.43 until a separate release plan advances it.
rollback.desktopProfile: No real Profile, package or process mutation is included.
rollback.hostCache: Delete <dshHome>/dsh-safe-plugin-manager/discovery-cache.json to drop the cached document; the client falls back to the direct read.

healthCheck: Run the disposable Desktop and host discovery tests, npm run check, npm pack dry-run, typed-plan verification and exact-head PR CI. Report real Desktop/Profile acceptance separately.

verification.nativeAbortEvidence: AbortError.code is the number 20, so it must not be read as a Desktop error code.
verification.publishedDocumentSizes: registry/discovery-index.json is 10,381,927 bytes raw and 2,560,593 bytes gzip with 24,171 entries; registry/catalog.json is 1,941,790 bytes raw and 246,780 bytes gzip.
verification.measuredLink: The measured GitHub throughput on this machine is 15-26 KB/s, so the published documents need minutes rather than the previous 12 s / 45 s budgets.
verification.realDesktopProfile: unchanged; update and visible UI acceptance require separate confirmation
